answer: Each agent must paint a hollow meadow: the beacon emits a pigment seed each epoch, and the agent must dye a unique petal. The first stroke costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent stroke doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at stroke 14 (20.4 M iterations). A pigment audit verifies each petal against the epoch seed; any faded color voids the canvas. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full meadow cost because each petal binds to the unique identity key—no shared palette possible.
